decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The external surfaces of the development shall be faced with materials to match the exterior of the main building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1AP05, 1AP-001, 002, 003, 004, 005, 006, 007, 008, 009, 010, 7AR22, 56, 57, B'ment, G'nd & 1st Floor Plan, 2nd, 3rd & Roof Plan, Elevations, Sections, 1AP08 received 20/04/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays.
description: The erection of a lift shaft extension including a 1.1m roof top overrun.
